# onetsolutions_hosting_ftp_accounts (Data Source)

Lists the FTP accounts of a web hosting, its main account included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_ftp_accounts" "all" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "ftp_accounts" {
  value = [for item in data.onetsolutions_hosting_ftp_accounts.all.ftp_accounts : item.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `ftp_accounts` (Attributes List) The FTP accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ftp_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--ftp_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ftp_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `home_directory` (String) The absolute path of the account's directory.
- `quota_mb` (Number) The disk quota in MB; 0 means unlimited.
- `quota_used_mb` (Number) The disk space used, in MB.
- `username` (String) The username of the account.
